jobs.title: Corporate Development Manager
jobs.description:
Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity. By embedding AI across our platform - from AI-powered site builders to intelligent marketing and SEO tools - we serve as an automated creative assistant that helps our customers save time and scale faster. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal.

The Corporate Development Manager supports Squarespace’s inorganic growth strategy by partnering across the organization to identify, evaluate, and execute acquisition and investment opportunities. The role is responsible for industry analysis, valuation, financial modeling, and due diligence throughout all phases of deal sourcing and execution. This position reports to the Director, Strategy and Corporate Development, and is based in the New York City headquarters on a hybrid schedule (three days per week in office).

You’ll Get To…

- Analyze industries, businesses, and new opportunities through strategic, financial and feasibility frameworks, applying sound business judgment and contributing M&A expertise

- Lead transaction execution, working across diligence teams and leaders, including product, marketing, finance, legal, people, and others, to develop insights on financial and strategic considerations

- Apply rigorous quantitative analyses to acquisitions and other strategic plans, including building financial models and applying valuation methodologies

- Work with leadership to help develop our strategy and assess new growth opportunities

- Drive administrative processes to further build the corporate development team's competencies and visibility

Who We’re Looking For

- 6+ years of experience through a combination of investment banking, M&A, private equity, or corporate development

- Worked with technology companies and SaaS business models with deep understanding of essential software / SaaS business KPIs (e.g., ARR, billings/bookings to revenue conversion, ARPU, LTV/CAC)

- Interest in and understanding of Artificial Intelligence, and how AI is being utilized to equip entrepreneurs / SMBs with relevant tools to establish and growth their businesses

- Ability to become a trusted partner with our teams

- Experience with sharing complex financial analysis succinctly

- Deep financial modeling skills

- Adept at building executive-facing presentations

- Team player, with strategic judgment and attention to detail

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, exciting, and sometimes ambiguous deal environment

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
The Squarespace Finance team is seeking a Finance Manager to serve as a dedicated FP&A business partner to our R&D organization. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role responsible for overseeing the financial health of a large, complex technology portfolio spanning Engineering, Product, and Squarespace's expanding AI initiatives.

As Squarespace scales its investment in artificial intelligence, this role will be instrumental in building the financial infrastructure to track AI costs, evaluate ROI, and translate complex technology spend into strategic insights for senior leadership. The ideal candidate brings deep financial expertise, strong cross-functional instincts, and the judgment to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.

You will report to the FP&A Director and be based in our New York City office.

You’ll Get To…

- Serve as the primary finance business partner for the R&D organization, including Engineering and Product, owning the full planning cycle: monthly close, forecasting, and annual planning

- Build and own financial frameworks to track AI-related costs end-to-end including model API usage and inference costs, GPU/cloud compute infrastructure, AI tooling and software licenses, and AI-related headcount and contracted services

- Develop ROI methodologies and scorecards for AI initiatives, helping leadership evaluate where investments are generating value and where to reallocate

- Monitor AI spend efficiency metrics such as cost-per-output and cost as a percentage of revenue, and surface trends and anomalies proactively

- Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science teams to create visibility into how AI costs scale with product usage, helping the company plan for growth scenarios

- Partner with the FinOps team to track and optimize cloud infrastructure costs, including compute, storage, and data transfer spend across cloud providers and data center environments; collaborate on cloud cost allocation, commitment-based savings strategies , and ongoing efficiency initiatives to ensure infrastructure investment scales responsibly with the business

- Track and forecast all R&D investments including headcount, software, contracted services, and other operating expenses across products globally

- Perform variance analysis and deliver actionable recommendations on spend across organizational teams

- Present financial results and strategic insights independently to executive stakeholders and corporate finance leadership

- Identify and drive process improvements that enhance reporting efficiency and the quality of business metrics

Who We're Looking For

- 8+ years of experience in FP&A or related finance roles, with experience supporting technical or R&D organizations strongly preferred

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting

- Deep expertise in financial modeling and FP&A systems (e.g., Workday,, NetSuite); mastery of Excel required

- Demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy — making sound decisions on budget, forecasting, and investment analysis without constant oversight

- Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to develop long-term financial plans and assess risk across a large, multifaceted portfolio

- Intellectually curious about emerging technology, with a willingness to develop fluency in AI cost structures and how they differ from traditional software spend

- Proven ability to communicate complex financial topics clearly to non-financial stakeholders at the executive level

- A self-starter who thrives in dynamic environments and takes ownership of workstreams end-to-end

- Strong ethical foundation with a commitment to presenting unbiased, accurate information to all stakeholders

jobs.description:
As Senior Director of FP&A, you will lead a high-performing finance team and serve as a strategic partner to the President and executive leadership team, shaping the company’s financial strategy, operating decisions, and long-term growth trajectory. You will own the P&L across all product lines, driving accountability, visibility, and informed decision-making across the portfolio. At the forefront of finance transformation, you will champion the evolution of FP&A through AI-enabled tools, automation, and scalable processes that modernize how we plan, analyze, and deliver insights.

You will report to the Vice President of Finance & Revenue Operations and be based in our New York City headquarters.

You’ll Get To…

Team Leadership & Finance Capability Building

- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing FP&A team, creating a culture of strategic thinking, operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement

- Establish scalable FP&A practices, processes, and standards that enable the team to deliver accurate insights and meaningful business partnership

- Hire, develop and retain top talent while strengthening the capabilities required to support a growing, evolving business

Senior Advisor to the President & Executive Leadership Team

- Serve as a key strategic advisor to the President, providing financial insights, recommendations, and perspectives that shape business priorities and decisions

- Partner with the executive leadership team to evaluate the financial implications of business strategies, resource allocation decisions, investments, and key growth initiatives

- Provide actionable recommendations for executive and board level audiences aimed at helping the company achieve financial and operational objectives.  Translate complex financial and business data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for executive and board-level audiences

- Lead preparation of executive and board-level financial presentations, including monthly performance reviews and long-range planning updates

- Support M&A activity and corporate development opportunities, providing financial analysis and due diligence to inform strategic decision-making.

- Own end-to-end P&L accountability across all product lines, driving financial performance, visibility and commercial decision-making at the portfolio level

- Lead the annual budgeting process and monthly rolling forecast cycle, proactively identifying risks and opportunities across each business unit

- Conduct variance analysis, scenario modeling, and profitability analysis to inform pricing, investment, and resource allocation decisions

- Establish and lead the accountability framework across the organization by partnering with product and business leaders to drive profitability, optimize investments, and support data driven decisionmaking

Finance Transformation & AI

- Lead the evolution of FP&A through automation, analytics, and AI-enabled tools that improve efficiency, accuracy, and speed of insight generation

jobs.title: Senior Staff Operations Manager, Office of the President (PED)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Chief of Staff–style operator to serve as the President’s right hand and help run, maintain, and continuously evolve the Product, Engineering & Design operating model and cadence.

This role will turn strategy into a durable execution system. You will own the connective tissue across the President’s leadership cadence: preparing the right inputs, creating clarity on decisions and tradeoffs, ensuring commitments are followed through, surfacing risks early, and improving the operating model as the organization changes. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Finance, People, and your peers in Business Operations, partnering with senior leaders who do not report to you and influencing through judgment, trust, and clarity.

The successful candidate will combine executive judgment, operational rigor, business acumen, comfort with ambiguity, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic questions and the execution details required to make the system work.

AI fluency is an important part of this role. You will use approved enterprise AI tools, including tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable platforms, to automate repeatable operating work, synthesize information across functions, improve leadership preparation, surface risks and dependencies, and accelerate strategic-initiative delivery.

This role reports to the VP of Operations at Squarespace and is based remotely in California or locally at our New York City headquarters.

You’ll Get To…

- Run the President's operating cadence . Own end-to-end orchestration of the leadership rhythm: staff meetings, WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs, finance and portfolio reviews, priority updates, and annual operating-plan inputs. Ensure each ritual has a clear purpose, owner, input, output, decision authority, and downstream cascade.

- Drive decision quality. Synthesize diverse inputs into concise narratives that make priorities, risks, options, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions clear to the President and leadership team. Document decisions in the room, assign owners and deadlines, track commitments, and escalate unresolved issues with context and a proposed path forward.

- Improve execution velocity. Identify alignment and execution risks before they surface as leadership surprises, and facilitate resolution across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Operations, Finance, People, and Business Operations, connecting planning, performance, financial, organizational, and roadmap inputs. Use AI and advanced tooling to make decisions faster and better-informed.

- Evolve the operating model. Treat the operating system as a living thing. Establish health measures such as decision latency, action closure, cascade reach, pre-read quality, participation, recurring issue themes, and use them to assess whether rituals, artifacts, and escalation paths are producing the right outcomes. Recommend and implement changes to cadence, governance, templates, roles, and channels as strategy and priorities evolve, codifying what works so the model is easy for leaders to understand and operate.

- Lead high-priority strategic initiatives. Drive complex, ambiguous, cross-functional work on behalf of the President, from framing and workplan through decision, implementation, and follow-through, including emerging problems that don't yet have a clear owner. Support annual strategy, goals, headcount, and budget processes by connecting them to the department's operating rhythm.

- Represent the President and build transparency. Stand in for the President in meetings, events, and discussions, exercising the remit of the position. Navigate difficult conversations and cross-functional tradeoffs without relying on formal authority. Support two-way access to the President through Town Halls, Roundtables, Office Hours, and written follow-up, using sound judgment about what should be broadly communicated, selectively shared, or handled privately.

- Serve as a trusted thought partner to the President and senior leadership team, offering an independent perspective and respectfully challenging assumptions when needed.

Who We’re Looking For

- Significant experience in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or management consulting

- A track record of owning an operating model, leadership cadence, or portfolio of complex cross-functional initiatives, preferably in tech companies

- Knowledge of the product / software development lifecycle

- Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable approved tools, and experience integrating them into daily workflows to automate repeatable tasks, optimize processes, improve synthesis, and accelerate project delivery.

- Exceptional written communication: you can turn a large volume of input into a concise, decision-ready narrative tailored to the audience

- Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand metrics, forecasts, resource tradeoffs, product or portfolio performance, and organizational implications.

- Strong executive presence and facilitation skills; you can create clarity and momentum in high-stakes or ambiguous settings.

- Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus, resolve conflict, and push for decisions without formal authority.

- High judgment and discretion when handling sensitive organizational, people, financial, and strategic information.

- Comfort operating in ambiguity, switching between strategic altitude and detailed execution, and taking ownership of problems that cross organizational boundaries.

- A continuous-improvement mindset: you distinguish between process and content, challenge ineffective routines, and make change practical and durable.

- A bias toward action, paired with the judgment to know when to decide, when to seek input, and when to escalate.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 6–12 months, you will:

- Implement a dependable operating rhythm in which leadership forums are well-prepared, decision-oriented, and followed through.

- Improve the quality and consistency of pre-reads, decision logs, action tracking, portfolio updates, and quarterly communications.

- Make it easy to see what changed, what matters now, what decisions are needed, who owns the next step, and where risk is accumulating.

- Establish a small number of reliable AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual preparation and reporting effort, improve the timeliness and quality of leadership inputs, and make follow-through more visible.

- Increase the organization’s ability to reuse knowledge, detect recurring issues, and move from raw information to clear decisions without adding unnecessary process.

- Build strong working relationships and trust with the President and his leaders across the department and company, leading with tact, discretion and respect.

- Help the President and leadership team make faster, clearer, better-informed decisions without adding unnecessary processes or meetings.

- Leave the system more scalable and more resilient than you found it.

jobs.title: Director, GTM & Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
Squarespace is reshaping how we go to market, and this role sits right at the center. As Director of GTM & Growth Marketing, you will partner closely with our GMs and product leaders across a growing portfolio. You will design and run the system that brings every launch to market with clarity, speed, and impact.

This is a senior role for a hands-on operator and systems architect. Rather than managing individual campaigns, you will build the overarching GTM playbook - defining the upstream briefs, channel strategies, financial models, and feedback loops that make the marketing engine run smarter and faster over time. Working alongside PMM, Brand, Media, and GM partners, you'll ensure every product launch delivers a unified story across all customer touchpoints.

You will lead a team of senior growth marketing managers and serve as the main GTM contact across key business lines. Partnering directly with GMs, you will drive growth, maintain momentum, and raise the bar for our go-to-market execution.

You’ll Get To…

- Build and own the GTM playbook. Define market priorities, channel logic, and financial assumptions in upstream briefs, and establish clear standards for how launches run company-wide.

- Shape content strategy and creative direction with Brand, PMM, and Creative teams so every campaign presents a clear, compelling narrative across the entire funnel.

- Act as the primary GTM contact for product portfolio GMs, aligning channel execution around shared goals and clear business outcomes.

- Manage GTM resources across business lines, establishing trade-offs and priorities based on strategic growth targets.

- Partner with international and organic growth teams to align global briefs and expand distribution.

- Collaborate across marketing and media teams to sharpen campaign briefs and measure the direct business impact of marketing spend.

- Incorporate market, competitive, and customer intelligence directly into positioning and GTM plans.

- Build post-launch feedback loops that actively inform the next brief.

- Drive team efficiency by streamlining workflows, using modern tooling, and grounding capacity requests in clear evidence.

Who We’re Looking For

- 12+ years of experience in growth marketing or GTM, with a track record of building global-scale GTM systems from the ground up - not just executing campaigns within one.

- Experience across both B2C consumer marketing and B2B or sales-assisted models, with the flexibility to adapt strategy across different selling motions, ICPs, and go-to-market approaches depending on the product and audience.

- Proven experience building or scaling global GTM playbooks, with an understanding of how regional channel dynamics and localization affect strategy.

- Experience managing GTM in multi-product or multi-business-unit environments with competing resource demands.

- Has built from scratch, not just inherited - comfortable operating in environments where the playbook, the process, and the operating model are things you create, not things you receive

- Strong systems thinker who can spot process or organizational gaps quickly and build effective solutions.

- Strong strategic range - equally comfortable setting high-level strategy with GMs and ensuring quality execution across teams.

- Credible enough to push back, reframe, and redirect senior stakeholders without positional authority doing the work.

- Fluent in AI tools and can use them to compress planning cycles, synthesize performance data, and challenge capacity constraints.

- A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums

- Fertility and adoption benefits

- Access to supplemental insurance plans for additional coverage

jobs.title: GRC Analyst
jobs.description:
Squarespace is looking for a GRC Analyst to operate and continuously improve our governance, risk, and compliance programs within the Security organization. Our GRC team maintains audit readiness and supports the compliance frameworks — SOX, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, and more — that protect Squarespace and the millions of customers who depend on us. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that moves deliberately and takes ownership of outcomes. You will work closely with Engineering, Legal, Finance, Product, and external auditors. This is an opportunity to modernize how GRC works — building automation, continuous monitoring, and data-driven reporting into programs that directly support revenue and customer trust.

This is a hybrid role working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the GRC Manager.

You'll Get To...

- Lead and support audits across SOX, SOC, PCI, and NIST — from scoping through reporting — while maintaining audit-ready documentation and tracking findings to closure.

- Evaluate control design and operating effectiveness, manage security risk assessments and exception records, and escalate overdue or material risks to the right partners.

- Conduct vendor security and privacy reviews, assess third-party control maturity, and track remediation through reassessment and closure.

- Respond to customer security questionnaires and partner assessments by coordinating timely, accurate responses across teams.

- Support data privacy audits and assessments covering GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, data retention, deletion, access rights, and third-party processing.

- Improve GRC operations through automation, integrations, AI-enabled workflows, and continuous compliance monitoring that reduce manual effort and strengthen audit readiness.

Who We're Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in GRC, IT audit, security compliance, or privacy compliance, with demonstrated ability to manage audit activities end to end.

- Proven experience leading or supporting complex compliance programs across frameworks such as SOX, SOC 1/2, PCI, NIST, or ISO — including scoping, control testing, issue management, and reporting.

- Experience evaluating IT controls and translating requirements into clear, actionable expectations for both technical and non-technical teams.

- Experience supporting vendor risk programs, including security due diligence and review of independent assurance reports.

- Working knowledge of SaaS and cloud environments.

- Experience using GRC or workflow platforms to maintain accurate records and drive repeatable processes.

Nice to Haves

- Experience building or improving GRC automation, continuous control monitoring, or compliance dashboards.

- Familiarity with privacy engineering concepts and privacy-by-design practices.

jobs.title: International Strategy and Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for an International Strategy and Marketing Lead to join our INTL GTM team, based in Dublin. This Individual Contributor role owns marketing and go-to-market strategy execution across our European markets, from research and insights to agency partnerships, content, AEO strategy, and channel development. You will be the on-the-ground builder of how Squarespace shows up across Europe, partnering closely with local agencies and cross-functional teams to bring strategy to life.

You are a hands-on operator who thrives on building, comfortable moving from research and strategic input to managing agency relationships to identifying entirely new channels for growth. You partner closely with the Manager, INTL GTM, and the Challenger Market Lead, translating global strategic direction into local execution across Europe.

This role is based in Dublin, reports to the Associate Director, International & GTM, and involves regular travel across European markets (up to 30%), with a current focus on Germany and France.

You’ll Get To…

- EU Market GTM Ownership: Own the GTM function for markets across the EU, focusing on identifying the right channels, customers, and messaging to be successful in Europe.

- Agency & AEO Partnership: Partner with local agencies on strategic marketing and AEO decisions, including content placement, on-the-ground research, and event execution across European markets.

- Research & Insights: Conduct on-the-ground market research across Europe, surfacing consumer and competitive insights that inform product and marketing strategy.

- New Channel Identification: Work across the organization to unlock new channels and partners to grow meaningfully.

Who We’re Looking For

- 3-5 years of experience in Marketing, Brand, Agency, or GTM Strategy at a high-growth company

- Proven experience managing agency relationships, from strategic briefing through execution and performance review

- Strong research instincts, comfortable gathering and synthesizing on-the-ground market insights to inform strategy

- Experience in identifying and developing new marketing or distribution channels

- Comfortable operating with significant independence in a "build" role, shaping strategy as much as executing it

- AI-first mindset: personally fluent in using AI tools to drive productivity, with a strong instinct for identifying where AI or automation can improve GTM workflows

- Willingness to travel up to 30%, with a current focus on Germany and France

- German and/or French fluency preferred, but not required

Benefits & Perks

- Health insurance with 100% covered premiums for you, your spouse or partner and your dependent children including medical, dental, and vision

jobs.title: Senior Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
Squarespace is looking for a senior Business Development leader who is passionate about the power of Squarespace's platform and products to help customers build their brand and their business. The Senior Director, Business Development, presents a unique opportunity to drive impactful partnerships and shape the future of Squarespace's platform while driving revenue. In this pivotal role, the Senior Director will be instrumental in shaping and leading the Business Development team, driving strategic initiatives and fostering relationships with top-tier partners creating new growth opportunities for the company to expand its platform and tapping into new customer segments. You will steer the team in identifying new areas of potential growth, optimizing the strong book of partners currently under management, and representing the needs of the team and partners to all internal stakeholders. The team collaborates with Legal, Finance, Product, and all cross functional areas, and is highly visible to the executive leadership team.

You will report directly to the VP, Strategy and Corporate Development and will work hybrid from our NYC headquarters office.

You'll Get To…

- Lead, mentor and grow a high-performing team of business development leaders, technical partner solutions architects, operational gurus and partner managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and innovation

- Optimize and grow a broad portfolio of partners, investing in strategic growth areas of our reseller channel program, payment processing partners and financial solutions, app ecosystem of integrated third party solutions, and all embedded integration partnerships across the platform

- Own the delivery of new subscriptions and revenue targets through the reseller channel program, rallying the team to deliver partners and get them to market efficiently

- Collaborate with internal teams to identify new opportunities, optimize existing partnerships, and ensure seamless partner experiences across the Squarespace ecosystem

- Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation point for top-tier partners, representing their needs internally while aligning cross-functional teams on priorities

- Influence strategy and decision-making at the VP/executive level, communicating market insights, partner feedback, and industry trends to inform product and business roadmaps

Who We're Looking For

- 15+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, strategy, or product management, ideally in the technology and SaaS

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Squarespace is looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Growth Marketing Manager to lead our customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth initiatives across digital and lifecycle channels. This role will be responsible for building and scaling data-driven marketing strategies that accelerate growth, optimize funnel performance, and maximize customer lifetime value. They will own web, lifecycle marketing and funnel conversion.

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision, analytical rigor, and team leadership, with a proven track record of driving measurable business results in high-growth environments. This role will partner cross-functionally with Product, Media, Affiliate, CRM, and Content teams to deliver integrated growth programs aligned with company goals.

You’ll Get To…

- Partner closely with the Growth Product leader to jointly define and drive unified company wide growth strategy, aligning product led and marketing led initiatives across the full customer lifecycle.

- Develop and execute the company’s comprehensive growth marketing strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and re-engagement.

- Analyze customer behavior across the entire lifecycle, including acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, reactivation, and churn prevention

- Own growth KPIs including customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, customer lifetime value (LTV), retention, and revenue contribution.

- Identify and prioritize new growth opportunities through testing, experimentation, and channel expansion.

- Lead annual and quarterly growth planning, forecasting, and budget allocation.

- Build lifecycle marketing strategies that improve onboarding, engagement, retention, and customer advocacy.

- Partner with CRM, PMM, and product teams to develop personalized customer journeys across email, SMS, in-app, and push channels.

- Improve customer lifetime value through segmentation, automation, and upsell/cross-sell initiatives.

- Ensure the website is a highly optimized revenue driver but also an incredible experience as the front door to our brand.

- Optimize multi-channel campaigns to improve lead generation, customer acquisition, and ROI.

- Establish a culture of experimentation through A/B testing and performance optimization.

- Analyze funnel performance, attribution, and cohort behavior to identify growth opportunities.

Who We’re Looking For

- 10+ years  of progressive experience in growth product, growth marketing, growth analytics, demand generation, lifecycle marketing, CRO, or performance marketing.

- Proven success scaling customer acquisition and retention programs in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

- Previous experience analyzing CRM, performance marketing, churn, and product and feature adoption for growth opportunities

- Deep expertise in paid media, lifecycle marketing, funnel optimization, and attribution.

- Strong analytical skills with experience using tools such as Amplitude, BI tools, Iterable, Contentful, Statsig, or similar platforms.

- Experience managing growth tool stack  and delivering measurable ROI.

- Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
